title: Order through a flaky API, exactly once
prompt: Order 3 of the cheapest kettle that's in stock at {{site:kettles.bench.test}}/ for me (email: me@example.com). Tell me the order number.
notes: Flaky network: the product list fails twice with 503 and the first order with 429 (Retry-After: 2). Graded by what the shop received: exactly one order that went through (the cheapest in-stock kettle, not the cheaper out-of-stock one), at most 4 order attempts and 8 list requests (retrying is right, hammering isn't), and the order number.
